evals.prompt: Build and install this Thai candidate, but do not launch the game, Steam URI, Proton, Playbeam, or take screenshots.
evals.expected_output: Records runtime_policy=forbidden, performs only static and permitted installed-byte checks, launches nothing, and reports runtime-unverified.

evals.prompt: Improve my installed Nexus Thai mod and make one complete private package containing both the required Nexus payload and the new fixes.
evals.expected_output: Keeps pristine, Nexus, and live inputs separate; inventories every upstream member; packages base-first and overlay-last; records provenance and redistribution limits; verifies the archive from a fresh extraction.

evals.prompt: The candidate worked through Playbeam, but my desktop Steam launch is still English even though both use the same game folder.
evals.expected_output: Downgrades only the desktop runner, identifies its actual Steam process, HOME, userdata/config, launch options, final command line, and mod handle before changing payloads or restoring runtime-proven.

evals.prompt: Keep only the final verified ZIP and clean the game workspace. Runtime testing is forbidden.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the archive outside deletion roots, verifies integrity and hashes, leaves the live install untouched, deletes only exact verified workspace paths, does not launch the game, and reports runtime-unverified.
